questions.question: Quelle commande affiche les datafiles d'un tablespace ?
Quel privilege permet de creer des sequences ?
Quelle commande verifie si un utilisateur existe ?
Quelle commande accorde SELECT sur une table a un utilisateur ?
choices: GRANT SELECT ON table TO user
ALLOW SELECT ON table TO user
GRANT READ ON table TO user
questions.correct_answer: GRANT SELECT ON table TO user
accept: GRANT SELECT ON table TO user

questions.question: Quelle commande definit le quota illimite sur un tablespace ?
choices: ALTER USER x QUOTA UNLIMITED ON ts
questions.correct_answer: ALTER USER x QUOTA UNLIMITED ON ts
accept: ALTER USER x QUOTA UNLIMITED ON ts
